"use client"; import React, { useState } from "react"; import { Dimensiones } from "../types"; import { Sliders, Home, Maximize2, Minimize2, Check } from "lucide-react"; interface InteractivePlanoProps { dimensiones: Dimensiones; onChange: (dims: Dimensiones) => void; } export default function InteractivePlano({ dimensiones, onChange }: InteractivePlanoProps) { const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false); const handleSlider = (name: keyof Dimensiones, val: number) => { onChange({ ...dimensiones, [name]: val }); }; const { largo, ancho, altura, espesorMuro, habitaciones } = dimensiones; const area = largo * ancho; return (
{/* Controles Deslizantes y Parámetros (Lado Izquierdo - 2 Columnas) */}

Parámetros del Plano

handleSlider("largo", parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="w-full h-2 bg-slate-950 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-sky-500 border border-slate-800" />
